conclusion.statement: Dimension-general conditioning fired on every iteration and made factor 1 admissible on all 89 iterations of all five frames, but its internal damping reduced actual traversal below both the matched current-tree control and the banked selected-factor proxy. All terminals remained diverted with finite X points while residuals became much larger, so the apparent admissible-step frontier move is not a convergence gain.
